meta.name: ai-social-media-content
meta.description: Create AI-powered social media content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Twitter/X. Generate: images, videos, reels, shorts, thumbnails, captions, hashtags. Tools: FLUX, Veo, Seedance, Wan, Kokoro TTS, Claude for copywriting. Use for: content creators, social media managers, influencers, brands. Triggers: social media content, tiktok, instagram reels, youtube shorts, twitter post, content creator, ai influencer, social content, reels, shorts, viral content, thumbnail generator, caption generator, hashtag generator, ugc content

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成社交媒体图文视频内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要批量制作社交媒体帖子、视频和文案。
copy.tagline_en: Create social media images, videos, and captions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce social media posts, videos, and copy at scale.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过命令行生成 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube 等平台的图片、视频、缩略图、字幕和话题标签，并支持批量创建和跨平台内容改编。
howto.when: 当你要求制作社交媒体内容，或提到“TikTok”、“Instagram Reels”、“YouTube Shorts”等平台时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个TikTok风格的短视频，主题是东京夜景。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Veo 模型生成 9:16 竖屏视频。

say.text: 为我的Instagram帖子写一段带话题标签的文案。
制作一个YouTube缩略图，主题是“AI趋势”。
say.note: Claude 会调用 FLUX 生成 16:9 缩略图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate images, videos, reels, shorts, thumbnails, captions, and hashtags for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Twitter/X via command line, and supports batch creation and cross-platform repurposing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create social media content or mention platforms like "TikTok", "Instagram Reels", "YouTube Shorts", etc.

say_en.text: Generate a TikTok-style short video about Tokyo night view.
say_en.note: Claude will use Veo model to create a 9:16 vertical video.

say_en.text: Write an Instagram caption with hashtags for my post.
say_en.note: Claude will use Claude Haiku to generate caption and tags.

say_en.text: Create a YouTube thumbnail for a video about AI trends.
say_en.note: Claude will use FLUX to generate a 16:9 thumbnail.
